title: Top-degree currents as scalar functionals on C_c^∞ (Step 1 of Simon 2.34)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ an arbitrary set and T ∈ D_n(U) (Lean: T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), a linear functional on the test n-forms Dⁿ(U) = TestFormOn U (m + 1) satisfying the continuity axiom GeometricCurrentOn.continuous': T(ω_k) → 0 whenever ω_k → 0 in the sense of TestFormOnConverges). Call b : ℝⁿ → ℝ admissible if b is C^∞, has compact support and spt b ⊆ U (spt g denotes the closed support of g, the closure of {g ≠ 0}; Lean: tsupport g). Let e = (e_1,…,e_n) be the standard basis of ℝⁿ (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Then there is a function u : (ℝⁿ → ℝ) → ℝ such that: (i) T(ω) = u(x ↦ ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n)) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U); (ii) for every admissible b there is ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) = b(x) for all x ∈ ℝⁿ; (iii) u(a + b) = u(a) + u(b) for all admissible a, b; (iv) u(c·a) = c·u(a) for all c ∈ ℝ and admissible a; (v) whenever K ⊆ U is compact, a_k (k ∈ ℕ) and b are C^∞ functions ℝⁿ → ℝ with spt a_k ⊆ K for all k and spt b ⊆ K, and for every q ∈ ℕ, D^q a_k → D^q b uniformly on ℝⁿ, then u(a_k) → u(b).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), ∃ u : (Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T ω = u (fun x => (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ b : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∃ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), ∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = b x) ∧ (∀ a b : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → u (a + b) = u a + u b) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → u (c • a) = c * u a) ∧ (∀ (a : ℕ → Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (b : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (a k)) → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → (∀ k, tsupport (a k) ⊆ K) → tsupport b ⊆ K → (∀ q : ℕ, TendstoUniformly (fun k x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (a k) x) (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q b x) atTop) → Tendsto (fun k => u (a k)) atTop (𝓝 (u b)))
